name: Kidnap
source:
When little Thuy can't find her taxi after a night out on the town, she gets in the wrong van with the wrong man. She wakes up bound to a chair in a dingy basement surrounded by knives, toys, and a sexual psychopath.

Will Thuy survive? And will her pussy ever be the same again?​

[From Itch.io]

Thuy能活下来吗？她的下体还能恢复如初吗？
